== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Legacy [[Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force (Errata 3)]] shares the [[Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force (Errata 2)]] column.
